profile.headline: Experienced Software and Embedded Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Software developer, designer, and architect for a wide range of markets, team sizes, and project durations.  I have deep experience in both the embedded realm and with system applications.  I'm detail-oriented and have a knack for staging product visions as stepwise projects.  I have experience with C, C++, Python, Javascript (etc.), Lua, Ruby, Perl, and assembly languages.

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description: Embedded systems engineering for components of an implantable ventricular assist device.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development of core software services without the Panasas storage system.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded software for network flow processing.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Sr. software engineer for embedded and systems applications pertaining to robotics and automation products.

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded software engineer for motor control and feedback in robotics applications.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead small teams of engineers to deliver systems for speech-driven, wireless computer systems.  I have an active role in formulating and propagating the overall architecture across product groups, the design of software and electrical systems, and the development of software in C, C++, and DSP assembly language.  I'm also involved in defining and refining the processes by which products are envisioned and developed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development of numerous projects in C and C++.  Lead designer and developer of a large, cross-platform ENMS project.  Developed several (both thick and thin) client-server applications for integrating wireless hand-held computers into customers' existing inventory and sales management systems.  Developer on embeddable 802.11 module and several derivative products such as micro-kiosks.   Involved many times in the debugging and correction of various 802.11- and Ethernet-based networking problems.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed SCADA systems and related tools for DOS, OS/2, and Windows.  Developed PLC and network interface converter firmware and communications protocols.  Software development in C and C++ for both PC and embedded systems.

positions.title: Systems Programmer
positions.description: Developed DOS- and Windows-based 5250 communications products (emulators and reverse emulators) coded C.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Designed and implemented Windows-based patient account tracking and corporate accounting software for outpatient medical facility using Paradox and custom utilities developed in C.
